doc.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
doc.interviewee: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum

title: Raymond Brown, little George's friend
summary: Charlotte asks about Raymond Brown, a drummer and her brother's close friend; her mother knows little about him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you know anything about Raymond Brown that was George's bosom buddy? That little George.
No, I can't tell you nothing about Raymond Brown. He used to call him George's little gut. Uh-huh. Raymond Brown.
He was talking about Raymond Brown, but I don't know. For a good time. That's right. That's H's fault about it.
Yeah. I don't know nothing about it.
He used to call him Big Gus and George's little gut. That's his body, you know.
Well, I don't know nothing about Raymond. I couldn't tell you. I thought you knew. I didn't know nothing about Raymond.
What did I know about? He was a fine drum roll guy. Yeah, Raymond.
I used to hear about Raymond Brown. And didn't Raymond live somewhere in college? Great time. Great time. I used to hear him. Like Oliver. I used to hear him talk about him.
